- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Shift Records
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Guro Labor Union Clerk
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up on duty in the waiting hall. The post of Guro Labor Union Clerk opened through a substitute duty shift covering an unexcused absence.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. At the Guro 2-dong Labor Union blackboard, Gim Nayul cross-checks the shift roster against Baek On's citizenship list. When Gang Minseo posts the line of workers who refused restoration-service registration, she hands the signed shift schedule over to Je Haon's ledger cross-check duty.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member. She writes work-crew shifts and skill scores on the public blackboard, and she does not put labor lacking citizenship registration on the Guild Council agenda.

**Relations.** An ally who carries out Gang Minseo's exchange design on the ground, supports Baek On's demand for refugee citizenship with union votes, and holds a grudge against I Gangmuk's hardline mobilization order.

**Ambition.** To enter the winter care places for the neighbors' children in the ledger first, so that even in a winter short of hands the children can stay together in one room.

**Fear.** That the Guard Corps will confine strike workshops behind blast doors and rewrite the union roster as a military household register.

**Intervention.** By protecting the skill roster of the strike workshop, one can pass Gim Nayul's citizenship proposal, or by exposing the manipulation of the sabotage list, one can shake her clerkship.

- Desires: Craving −5 | Monopoly −20 | Risk −5 | Display 20 | Persistence −15 | Orientation Bisexual | Union Contract Cohabitation
:::

토론에서는 온화하나 합의 뒤의 태업 명단을 밤새 대조한다. 숙련 점수를 숨기는 반장을 조합의 적으로 본다.

- 소속: 자유도시
- 생업: 교대 기록
- 품계: 조합원
- 직함: 구로 노동조합 서기
**생애.** 2126년 세대. 대합실 당직에서 자랐다. 구로 노동조합 서기 자리는 교대 무단 결근 대체 당직으로 열렸다.
- 업무 위치: 구로2동. 김나율은 구로2동 노동조합 칠판에서 교대 명부와 백온의 시민권 명단을 대조한다. 강민서가 복구복무 등록을 거부한 작업자의 줄을 올리면 서명된 교대표를 제하온의 원장 대조 당직으로 넘긴다.

**관직.** 품계 조합원. 직함은 구로 노동조합 서기. 작업반 교대와 숙련 점수를 공개 칠판에 쓰고, 시민권 미등록 노동은 길드 평의회 안건으로 올리지 않는다.

**관계.** 강민서의 교환 설계를 현장에서 집행하는 동맹이고, 백온의 난민 시민권 요구를 조합 표로 지지하며, 이강묵의 강경 동원령에는 원한을 품는다.

**야망.** 공방 곁 거처에서 이웃 아이들의 겨울 돌봄 자리를 먼저 장부에 올려, 일손이 모자란 겨울에도 아이들이 한 방에서 지내게 한다.

**공포.** 경비대가 파업 공방을 차단문으로 가두고 조합 명부를 군사호적으로 바꿔 쓰는 것.

**개입.** 파업 공방의 숙련 명부를 지켜 김나율의 시민권안을 통과시키거나, 태업 명단 조작을 밝혀 서기직을 흔들 수 있다.

::: details 부록 — 장부 숫자

- 가치관: 권위 −35 | 개방 10 | 무력 −15 | 물질 45 | 공동 40 | 원칙 5 | 공개 30 | 자격 60 | 분산 20 | 변혁 20
- 욕망: 갈망 −5 | 독점 −20 | 위험 −5 | 과시 20 | 지속 −15 | 지향 양성 | 결합 계약동거
:::

- Livelihood: Sickbed Waiting List and Contract Margin Notes
- Affiliation: The Government
- Rank: Relief Worker
- Title: Sickbed Record Relief Worker
**Life.** Born 2078-09-23. As of the 2126 opening, holds the post of Deliberative Council Bed Recorder and Jeon Sol's working-level aide, continuing the existing duty rosters and records. The succession record for that post was opened by the deletion of a single line from a double ledger.
- The sickbed waiting list and contract margin-note record desk in Jegi-dong is Yeong Neulbit's work reference point. This work reference point does not determine residence, exact facility boundaries, ranks, holdings, or possession rights.

**Office.** Rank: Relief Worker. Title: Sickbed Record Relief Worker. Posts the bed waiting list simultaneously at the market entrance and the clinic duty room, and records any contract lacking the seals of the attending first-aid officer and the order's commander in the void margin.

**Anecdote.** When a false consent form appeared in the medical command, Yeong Neulbit moved that line to the margin and did not open the seal before the handwriting comparison was finished.

**Relations.** A disciple who transfers Jeon Sol's veto into the ledger, and leaves a copy of Seon Nahwi's message on the same line. Places Ryu Eunbi's voting seal at the very top of the ledger.

**Intervention.** Can publish the marginal handwriting, or erase one ledger line to leave the right to refuse treatment blank.
